user.title: DIVA hub
user.description: Create the DIVA hub and add the first pet profile. Additional pets can be managed from Options.

data_description.species: Use a simple species label such as dog or cat.
data_description.avatar: Optional /local path or https URL for the pet photo.

camera_settings.name: Camera monitoring
camera_settings.description: Optional camera-based bowl monitoring. Bowl areas use x,y,width,height pixel coordinates.

routine_settings.name: Routine
routine_settings.description: Structured weekly planner with mode policies, weather thresholds, and one-off exceptions.

data_description.feeding_routines: Add structured meal slots with time, weekdays, meal type, and portion.
data_description.walk_routines: Add structured walk slots with time, weekdays, duration, and location.
data_description.care_routines: Add care/play/training/grooming slots without using a text DSL.
data_description.routine_exceptions: One-off skip, add, or move actions for a specific date.

calendar_settings.name: Calendar & Vet
calendar_settings.description: DIVA creates its own timeline calendar. External calendars can be linked here for Google Calendar or CalDAV-based Apple calendars.

data_description.calendar_links: Each link binds a calendar entity to a source_of_truth policy: diva, calendar, or manual_review.

passport_settings.name: Passport
passport_settings.description: Pet identity and veterinary passport fields.

tracking_settings.name: Tracking & Presence
tracking_settings.description: Optional GPS/BLE, household presence, and weather entities for adaptive modes and location context. Configure GPS/BLE entities, safe zones, room sources, and weather context.

data_description.safe_zones: Named safe zones for geofencing. Each item includes a zone name, latitude, longitude, and radius in meters.
data_description.room_presence_sources: Map BLE, binary, or sensor entities to room names for indoor location resolution.
data_description.camera_room_name: Optional room label for the linked camera so bowl activity can help room detection.

behavior_settings.name: Behavior Signals
behavior_settings.description: Optional behavior detection entities and caregiver list. Use this to connect external AI/vision pipelines.

data_description.caregivers: One caregiver per line or comma-separated.

nutrition_settings.name: Nutrition
nutrition_settings.description: Food catalog, transition plan, and calorie density used by nutrition analytics.

data_description.food_catalog: Track brand, food kind, meal type, and kcal per gram.
data_description.food_transition_plan: Dated transition steps must sum to 100% between the old and new food.

medical_settings.name: Medical
medical_settings.description: Vaccination policy, medication courses, chronic conditions, diagnoses, allergies, contraindications, weight goals, and medical history.

data_description.medical_country: Use an ISO country code such as ES for Spain.
data_description.medical_region: Optional regional policy key such as es_general or madrid.
data_description.body_condition_score: BCS scale 1-9, where 4-6 is the usual target range.
data_description.weight_goal_min_kg: Lower bound of the target body weight range in kilograms.
data_description.weight_goal_max_kg: Upper bound of the target body weight range in kilograms.
data_description.medication_courses: Set medication name, dose, schedule times, and course dates.
data_description.chronic_conditions: Track chronic conditions with monitoring intervals and notes.
data_description.vaccine_overrides: Add or override vaccine reminders, recurrence, and due dates.
data_description.diagnoses: Track diagnosed conditions with status, diagnosis date, and notes.
data_description.allergies: Track allergens, reactions, and handling notes.
data_description.contraindications: Track activities, drugs, or procedures to avoid and why.
data_description.medical_history: Store dated medical events such as illness, surgery, or recovery milestones.
data_description.regional_policy: Regional overlay key such as es_general, madrid, andalucia, galicia, or custom.
data_description.vaccine_profile: Default vaccine template selection for the pet.
data_description.vet_override: Allow configured vaccine overrides to replace default generated doses.

operations_settings.name: Operations
operations_settings.description: Care roles, caregiver shifts, recurring checklists, and approval rules for critical actions.

data_description.care_roles: Assign named caregivers to operational roles such as owner, sitter, or medical lead.
data_description.care_shifts: Define recurring caregiver shifts with label, time range, weekdays, and optional role.
data_description.checklist_items: Daily or weekly checklist tasks for grooming, medication, inspection, or training.
data_description.approval_required_actions: Actions that should be queued for approval instead of executing immediately.

error.invalid_weight: Weight must be greater than zero.
error.camera_required: Select a camera entity when bowl areas are configured.
error.duplicate_pet: A pet with the same identity already exists in DIVA.
error.invalid_schedule: Invalid structured schedule or exception entry.
error.invalid_temperature_window: Cold threshold must stay below heat threshold.
error.invalid_body_condition_score: Body condition score must be between 1 and 9.
error.invalid_weight_goal: Weight goal min must not exceed weight goal max.

abort.entry_not_found: The selected DIVA entry no longer exists.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The DIVA hub was updated successfully.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one DIVA hub is supported.

data_description.show_editor_in_sidebar: Hide the sidebar entry without disabling the DIVA editor route itself.
